description: Enroll in a misconfigured certificate template (client-auth EKU + enrollee-supplies-subject) to obtain a cert as any user.

telemetry.detail: Certificate Services received a certificate request (on the CA).
Certificate Services approved and issued a certificate (on the CA).
PKINIT TGT request using the issued certificate - certificate logon anomaly.
CA request/issue events are logged on the CA by default; the SAN-vs-requester mismatch is the tell. Certify/Certipy usage patterns are modelled by newer ITDR.

prerequisite_privilege: Enrollment rights on a vulnerable (ESC1) template
abuse_primitive: Certipy/Certify request with an alternate SAN (target = DA), then PKINIT.
notes: CA-side 4886/4887 are default-on and often centrally collected, so ADCS abuse is noisier than it is reputed to be where CA logs are shipped. The SAN anomaly is high-fidelity.
